text: Can a model's weights reveal what chips
trained it? One researcher says yes.
Will DePue of the nonprofit Unemployment Labs
Moonshot AI, MiniMax, and Ant Group.
He says the weights carry fingerprints of
the training hardware, and found compelling evidence
that models like Kimi K3 and DeepSeek
V4 were trained on Blackwell GPUs,
which are banned from export to China.
That doesn't prove they were trained entirely
on Nvidia chips, or that export laws
were broken. Epoch AI estimates two million
advanced chips entered China through hidden routes
